projects.description: Harness-native grouping of conversations; never VibeHub Project truth.

fork.description: Create a conversation branch with native lineage.

audio.description: Submit ordinary audio input to the selected harness.

attachments.description: Submit non-audio attachments supported by the selected harness.

approvals.description: Resolve a live harness-owned approval request.

tools.description: Render and observe harness-owned tool execution.

plans.description: Render and respond to harness-owned plan state.

delegatedWork.description: Render harness-owned subagent or delegated execution without turning it into VibeHub Tasks.

replay.description: Recover harness conversation history after restart.

interruption.description: Interrupt the selected harness's active execution.

livePresence.description: Project fresh runtime presence without making it durable Task state.

projects.source: ClientRequest threadSection/list, threadSection/create, threadSection/update, threadSection/delete and thread/section/move; Thread.section is the sole membership authority with built-in Pinned and sectionId-null Recents. 0.149.0 adds an app-server-owned Thread.projectId with project/changed and thread/project/updated notifications but no ClientRequest that assigns it; it is observed, never read as membership
projects.fallback: If fork placement races with Project deletion, the fork stays visible in unsectioned Recents with placement.applied=false; threadSection/delete returns member Threads to Recents. If a later pin makes Thread.projectId assignable, membership stays on Thread.section until a probe proves the new seam; projectId is never merged into it.

fork.fallback: Disable Fork if schema probing removes thread/fork.

search.fallback: Offer metadata-only local filtering and label content search unavailable.

audio.source: Turn input audio and localAudio variants
audio.fallback: Keep text input; hide microphone-live, transcript-live and audio-output claims while the pinned experimental thread/realtime probe reports protocol-present-current-ephemeral-thread-unsupported.

attachments.source: Turn input image and localImage variants
attachments.fallback: Keep text input and identify the rejected attachment.

approvals.fallback: Fail closed and keep the request visible.

tools.source: ThreadItem tool variants and item progress notifications
tools.fallback: Render an unknown native item without dropping transcript identity.

plans.fallback: Render plan content as a native unknown item; never mint Tasks.

delegatedWork.fallback: Render a bounded unknown item; never adapt it to DSH Agent Team or VibeHub Tasks.

replay.fallback: Stop reuse when stable Thread recovery fails.

interruption.fallback: Show interruption unavailable and do not claim stopped.

livePresence.fallback: Show no live state; replay never mints presence.

upstream.transport: native Session and client runtime services

projects.fallback: Expose native Workspaces without claiming they are VibeHub Projects.

fork.fallback: Disable Fork and keep the source Session unchanged.

search.source: ISessions.search over the Host visible message-content index
search.fallback: Offer list metadata filtering and label content search unavailable.

audio.source: PromptContentPart in rc.8 accepts text or image only
audio.fallback: Keep text and image input; do not display a working microphone.

attachments.source: PromptContentPart image and attachment-local durable references
attachments.fallback: Keep text input and identify the rejected image.

approvals.fallback: Fail closed and keep the pending interaction visible.

tools.fallback: Render durable Session events without inventing a successful tool result.

plans.fallback: Keep the Session waiting and do not begin implementation.

delegatedWork.source: base Bundle subagent packages and Session parent lineage
delegatedWork.fallback: Render native Session lineage only; never mirror Agent Team tasks.

replay.source: append-only Session log, history pagination and Session projections
replay.fallback: Stop association recovery if registered projection replay fails.

interruption.fallback: Show cancellation unavailable and do not claim stopped.

livePresence.fallback: Show no live state; replay never mints presence.
